rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is done using scientific methods or evidence.

example.english: We test the water scientifically to find out whether it is safe.
example.traditional: 用科學方法驗水質，先至知道安唔安全。
example.jyutping: jung6 fo1 hok6 fong1 faat3 jim6 seoi2 zat1 sin1 zi3 zi1 dou3 on1 m4 on1 cyun4

rows.note: Use this when making a claim from a scientific viewpoint rather than describing a procedure.

example.english: Scientifically, this claim doesn't make sense.
example.traditional: 科學上，呢個講法係講唔通嘅。
example.jyutping: fo1 hok6 soeng6 ni1 go3 gong2 faat3 hai6 gong2 m4 tung1 ge3

rows.note: Use this for approaching or handling something methodically and systematically, without necessarily emphasizing science.

example.english: If you organize your notes scientifically, you won't get so muddled.
example.traditional: 有系統咁整理啲資料，做功課就唔會咁亂。
example.jyutping: jau5 hai6 tung2 gam3 zing2 lei5 di1 zi1 liu2 zou6 gung1 fo3 zau6 m4 wui5 gam3 lyun6
